text: Many orphaned giant anteater pups in Brazil are still nursing when their mothers are killed in road collisions. At rehabilitation centers, caregivers bottle-feed them, provide around-the-clock care, and help them build strength for a possible return to the wild. Nat Geo Explorer @Fernando Faciole spent three years documenting these young animals and the people caring for them. See how researchers are making Brazil's roads safer for giant anteaters at the 🔗 in bio.

text: The shoebill’s prehistoric appearance makes it unique among living birds, with a look that matches fossils dating back millions of years. Its biology gets stranger still, with chicks attacking their own siblings and adults hunting everything from lungfish to baby crocodiles. Learn more about shoebills with these five facts.

text: This king penguin parent and its chick were among thousands that caught the eye of photographer @Martin Greguš Jr. South Georgia. King penguins have an unusually long reproductive cycle compared to other penguins, which means that eggs, chicks, and adults can all be present within a colony at the same time.
